links.outcome: Ambient transcription accuracy (WER, CER) for Hindi radiologist-patient conversations
links.effect: Lowest WER 0.577 and CER 0.379 at temperature 0 for Hindi transcription with Whisper large-v2, indicating poor non-English transcription accuracy.
links.quote: The lowest WER (0.577) and CER (0.379) were observed at temperature 0.

links.outcome: Errors in AI-generated mammography reports (missed/incorrect information)
links.effect: Errors present in 50% of AI-generated reports, predominantly missed and incorrect information, with higher error rate in malignant cases; mean concordance 0.94.
links.quote: Errors were present in 50% of AI-generated reports, predominantly missed and incorrect information, with a higher error rate in malignant cases.

unlisted_practices: Generating structured radiology reports from vernacular-language radiologist-patient conversations using ASR plus LLM
Generating multiple transcriptions at different Whisper temperatures to maximize information capture

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility, accuracy, and editing workflow (measuring error types and radiologist correction time) for generating structured mammography reports from simulated vernacular radiologist-patient dialogue using Whisper and GPT-4o.

primary.practice: radiologist review and editing of AI-generated reports
